preview_heading: Tridents meet Knight Riders in Bridgetown
preview: Barbados Tridents face Trinbago Knight Riders in CPL 2026 Match 27 at Kensington Oval. The match is scheduled for Sat 5 Sep at 8pm local time.
preview_detail: Barbados return to the Tridents identity and national colours in 2026, with Gudakesh Motie, Sherfane Rutherford and Brandon King among the senior Caribbean core. The 2025 champions retain a decorated core led by Sunil Narine, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard and Akeal Hosein as they pursue another title. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
